what: unary_bcast is documented as using unpack-to-dest for 32-bit formats, but it keys on get_operand_dst_format(icb), which is TF32 for a Float32 CB unless that CB is tagged UnpackToDestFp32. So an untagged fp32 Col broadcast silently truncates to tf32 (~8e-4 rel). The design (op_design.md, CB section) repeated the claim and excluded the bcast CB from the UnpackToDestFp32 list.
suggest: State in bcast.h / bcast.hpp (UnaryBcast) and in the numeric-formats reference that a Float32 broadcast source CB must be tagged UnpackToDestFp32 for the exact path; the chain could static/LLK-assert or warn when an fp32 bcast CB is untagged.

detail: probes: FPU matmul rounds each 16-term face partial to ~tf32 at all fidelities (2 exact products in one face lose 2^-11); one product per face exact; DEST accumulation across K tiles exact
stats T160/T150 pass with 16-pass masked exact projection at HiFi4
